mapper.insert: INSERT INTO register (case_number, real_name, gender, card_number, birthdate, age, age_type, home_address, visit_date, noon, department_id, employee_id, regist_level_id, settle_category_id, is_book, regist_method, regist_money, visit_state) VALUES (#{caseNumber}, #{realName}, #{gender}, #{cardNumber}, #{birthdate}, #{age}, #{ageType}, #{homeAddress}, #{visitDate}, #{noon}, #{departmentId}, #{employeeId}, #{registLevelId}, #{settleCategoryId}, #{isBook}, #{registMethod}, #{registMoney}, #{visitState})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM register WHERE case_number = #{caseNumber} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM register WHERE card_number = #{cardNumber} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE register SET visit_state = #{visitState} WHERE id = #{id}
